def get_isoform_masses(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}?format=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    comments = [c for c in res.get("comments", []) if c.get("commentType") == "ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS"]
    print(f"Isoforms for {accession}:")
    if comments:
        for iso in comments[0].get("isoforms", []):
            print(iso.get("name"), iso.get("isoformIds"))
